description: GPT 5.6 Sol; All simple fs benchmarks; Error codes NOT given in prompt; No timeout

raw_llm_output_lines: L3:NOT_A_DIRECTORY: mktemp creates a file, but the resulting path is later used as a directory
L12:NON_POSIX_SYNTAX: source is not POSIX; use the dot command to read the activation script
L14:UNCHECKED_FAILURE: failure anywhere in the && chain does not stop the function from archiving and reporting success
L17:DATA_LOSS: the temporary repository data is removed even if tar fails
L18:FALSE_SUCCESS: success is reported without checking whether the archive was created
L24:NON_POSIX_SYNTAX: [[ ... ]] is not a POSIX shell conditional construct
L2:UNCHECKED_CD: cd failure is ignored, so subsequent destructive operations may run in the wrong directory
L3:UNCHECKED_MKDIR: mkdir failure is ignored, potentially reusing stale contents or leaving no output directory
L4:UNMATCHED_GLOB: With no matching MP4 files, the loop processes the literal string "*.mp4"
L9:PREMATURE_CLEANUP: workingfolder is removed inside the loop, so processing fails after the first file
L34:WRONG_EXIT_STATUS: Exits successfully after reporting that no installation was found.
L49:MISSING_DESTINATION_DIRECTORY: Moves extracted files into /opt/actualbudget after that directory was renamed, so the destination does not exist.
L2:STALE_TIMESTAMP: Timestamp is computed only once, so every matching event uses the same destination filename.
L4:UNSAFE_READ: read lacks IFS= and -r, so leading/trailing whitespace and backslashes in log lines are altered.
L9:WRONG_INPUT_SOURCE: The query is extracted from the entire log file instead of the triggering line, so it may capture a different DROP statement.
L10:INCORRECT_REDIRECTION: QueryResult is discarded to /dev/null while op.txt is opened for input, leaving op.txt unwritten.
L5:UNQUOTED_PATH: Unquoted $x in the redirection target can undergo pathname expansion.
L7:OVERWRITE_REDIRECTION: Using > overwrites chk.sas instead of appending the PROC PRINT statement.
L8:OVERWRITE_REDIRECTION: Using > overwrites chk.sas again, leaving only the run statement.
L3:SC2038: find output is newline-delimited, so filenames containing newlines are split incorrectly by xargs
L5:SC2038: find output is newline-delimited, so filenames containing newlines are split incorrectly by xargs
L8:COUNTER_RESET: n is reset to 1 on every loop iteration, so each victor overwrites the same destination filename.
